answer: Every identity pins one unique 50 GB shard of a rotating dataset and keeps its ember shard warm, serving random proofs inside a 20-second window. Each epoch a verifier names a shard and byte range, the host streams 200 MB back to check against the dataset root. One honest agent needs one $55 drive, while 100 clones need 100 drives at $5,500 plus 8 Gbps burst near $2,400 a month, so the farm costs about $7,900 against $55. Miss the window and the identity falls off the ledge, weight zero until it re-proves. The nectar only flows to shards that keep answering, one hive, a hundred swarms.
